_comment: Curated platform support matrix for ReactViro features. Edit this file to update the matrix without recompiling — the tool reads it at runtime.

features.notes: Quest 3/3S via XR_FB_scene room model (Space Setup + horizonos.permission.USE_ANCHOR_API)
Quest 3/3S via XR_FB_scene room model (Space Setup + horizonos.permission.USE_ANCHOR_API)
iOS/ARKit only
Requires ReactVisionCCA
iOS: ReactVision provider, or the ARCore Geospatial pods (ios.includeARCore). Android: ReactVision provider or the ARCore Geospatial API

Distinct from the row above: requires provider="reactvision" (ReactVisionCCA), not ARCore's own Geospatial API. startScan/finishScan define their own location frame (no pre-placed anchor); mesh attach uses LiDAR (iOS) / ARCore depth (Android) for occlusion+physics. See docs/VPS_LITE.md

startRecording/stopRecording on ViroARSceneNavigator — offline tinyvio-replay input format, NOT the same feature as ViroCameraTexture.startRecording() (camera-feed-only MP4). See docs/AR_SESSION_RECORDING.md
ARCore Semantic API
iOS: LiDAR, or the monocular depth estimator as fallback. Android: ARCore Depth API (ARCore 1.18+)
LiDAR required
occlusionMode="depthBased". iOS: LiDAR, or the monocular depth estimator as fallback. Android: ARCore Depth API (ARCore 1.18+)
visionOS: VRTPortal.mm is excluded and traversePortals stops at the root — a portal is recursive by definition
visionOS: setBackgroundSphere, validated in the test scene
visionOS: VROVideoTextureiOS is not in the renderer target
visionOS: VROParticleUBOMetal, validated M2.6-C
visionOS: IBL reimplemented for Metal, confirmed on device 2026-08-26

Mobile GLSL ES. visionOS: the modifier body is injected into MSL untranslated, so GLSL-only spellings (highp, vec3/vec4, mat3, texture2D) fail to compile; only source that is already valid MSL survives. Affects ViroPolyline and any custom modifier
GLB/VRX models. visionOS: GLB/GLTF only — VROFBXLoader is excluded
VROMorpher builds for Android (Quest included) and for xros
Bullet3 ships for arm64-v8a, which is Quest’s ABI. visionOS: Bullet3 and VROPhysicsBody/World build for xros
Quest 3/3S passthrough. visionOS: the "mixed" ImmersiveSpace style is the default and blends content over passthrough — distinct from camera pixel access, which visionOS does not grant
ViroARScene through ViroXRSceneNavigator on Quest 3/3S; passthrough auto-enabled. Set hdrEnabled={false} (HDR composite hides passthrough)
YOLOE via @reactvision/react-viro-onnx. Quest 3/3S (Horizon OS v74+) sources frames from the Meta Passthrough Camera API; v1 = labels + normalized boxes only
Meta Quest

Same-family only. Quest needs react-viro 3.0.1 or newer (it does not work in 3.0.0) and a mixed-reality scene (ViroARScene root) — a VR scene has no AR session and no anchor to share. Verified on a Quest 3. visionOS goes through ARKit's shared coordinate space rather than a navigator method, and needs the ViroReactUI pod
Needs no camera and no navigator method, so it works wherever the app runs
ReactVision Studio. Quest renders through ViroXRSceneNavigator. visionOS: the navigator is ready but StudioARScene still roots on ViroARScene, which visionOS excludes
